name: armis-knowledge-skills
description: PROD environment (knowledge-api.moose.armis.com). Adds /knowledge, /cwe-fix, /framework-guidance, and /tech-guidance as shell skills that call the backend directly. Reads ARMIS_KNOWLEDGE_CLIENT_ID; loads client_secret from the OS keychain (service: armis-knowledge-prod). Tenant isolation enforced server-side; no knowledge data stored on disk.
